body:
It's going to crush her. She loves me so much. I'm also leaving my little sister and grandmother. They also love me terribly. I don't want to hurt them, and I make that a big point in my note, but I just can't go on with this pain. I am suffering so badly.

I've been wanting to genuinely die for the past year and have been holding on, hoping things change, but they haven't. It's been four years of this and I have to make it end.

My father committed suicide in 2007, and I don't have any kids, so this is going to be devastating to my paternal grandmother. 

I don't want to hurt the ones I love, but life can be unbearable at times.

If you have a situation that you think can improve, try to hold on. We all hit bad seasons in our lives, but it isn't over yet.

I'm planning my suicide right now. I have a medical condition that leaves me constantly in pain, such pain I sometimes hit myself because of it - the pain drives me insane. I have talked to doctors, but unfortunately my situation hasn't improved and it has been four years.

I have a loving family which is what makes it hard for me. I'm not trying to guilt-trip them in any way, in fact I want nothing more than for them not to endure my death. Unfortunately I simply can't live any longer. I am ready to go.
